change_summary: Replaced four-line clamp (tl.full 0.0, tl.maximum, tl.full 1.0, tl.minimum) with a single tl.clamp(tmp30, 0.0, 1.0) call, eliminating 3 intermediate temporaries and allowing the compiler to emit a single FMNMX instruction instead of two separate FP32 instructions.
